source.name: 2026-10-26用户人工复审词库

books.name: ICAO考前预习
books.description: 适合下分院前提前熟悉 ICAO 基础词汇，建立民航英语基本词汇印象。

words.meaning: 中止；中断正在实施的起飞等动作
words.example: The crew decided to abort the takeoff.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组决定中断起飞。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft began to accelerate along the runway.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机开始沿跑道加速。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew felt a sudden change in vertical acceleration.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组感觉到垂直加速度突然变化。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 告知已收到并理解信息；确认收悉
words.example: Please acknowledge receipt of the new clearance.
words.exampleTranslation: 请确认已收到新的管制许可。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If the airplane has a navigation radio, such as a VOR or ADF receiver, it can be possible to determine position by plotting an azimuth from two or more navigational facilities.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果飞机配备无线电导航，如 VOR 或 ADF 接收器，它可以通过两个或更多的导航设施绘制方位角来确定位置。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Advise the controller of your intentions.
words.exampleTranslation: 向管制员通报你的意图。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot replied, "Affirm, we have the traffic in sight."
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员回答:“是，我们已目视发现该航空器。”。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Smoke was reported in the aft lavatory.
words.exampleTranslation: 后部洗手间报告有烟雾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The engine bleed air system failed during the climb.
words.exampleTranslation: 爬升过程中，发动机引气系统失效。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported an air conditioning fault.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告空调故障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The air traffic controller noticed the runway obstruction.
words.exampleTranslation: 空中交通管制员注意到了跑道障碍物。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Air-ground communication was restored after the frequency change.
words.exampleTranslation: 频率变更后，空地通信恢复正常。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Air-to-air communication helped the pilots coordinate traffic avoidance.
words.exampleTranslation: 空对空通信帮助飞行员协调避让交通。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 离地飞行中的；机载或空运的
words.example: The crew reported the problem shortly after becoming airborne.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组在离地后不久报告了问题。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller issued traffic information due to aircraft proximity.
words.exampleTranslation: 由于航空器接近，管制员发布了交通信息。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: An open cockpit side window can cause sudden loud noise and strong airflow.
words.exampleTranslation: 驾驶舱侧窗开启会突然产生很大的噪声和强烈气流。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Airport surveillance radar detected the aircraft turning onto final.
words.exampleTranslation: 场面监视雷达探测到飞机转入五边。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.word: airport shuttle bus / airport passenger bus / ferry bus
words.example: An airport passenger bus carried travelers to the remote stand.
words.exampleTranslation: 一辆机场摆渡车将旅客送往远机位。
words.pronunciationText: airport shuttle bus. airport passenger bus. ferry bus

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft remained outside the restricted airspace.
words.exampleTranslation: 该航空器始终在受限空域之外。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot noticed a sudden decrease in airspeed.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员注意到空速突然下降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The flight plan included a different airway.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行计划包含了另一条航路。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The warning system alerted the crew to low fuel pressure.
words.exampleTranslation: 告警系统提醒机组燃油压力低。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew selected an alternate with better weather.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组选择了一个天气条件更好的备降机场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 高度；航空器相对规定基准的垂直距离
words.example: The aircraft maintained its assigned altitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器保持在指定高度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: An ambulance met the aircraft after the medical emergency.
words.exampleTranslation: 医疗紧急情况后，一辆救护车接应了飞机。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Last but not least, the pilot should overcome the nervous mood, and avoid the tension and anxiety to ensure the flight skills.
words.exampleTranslation: 最后，克服紧张的情绪，避免紧张和焦虑，确保飞行技能。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: In my work time, I am always fully present and I really appreciate every flight of my duty time.
words.exampleTranslation: 工作时，我完全投入，同时我很珍视每次飞行任务。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 进近；接近；Approach 在呼叫中也可指进近管制单位
words.example: Visibility deteriorated during the approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 进近过程中能见度恶化了。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A maintenance vehicle was parked on the apron.
words.exampleTranslation: 一辆维修车辆停在机坪上。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft was instructed to avoid the danger area.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机被指示避开危险区。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot requested assistance after a hydraulic warning appeared.
words.exampleTranslation: 液压警告出现后，飞行员请求协助。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 空中交通管制（Air Traffic Control，ATC）
words.example: The crew informed air traffic control of the problem.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组向空中交通管制部门通报了问题。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 自动航站情报服务（Automatic Terminal Information Service，ATIS）
words.example: You are maintaining 5100m over LKO, ATIS B is received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机飞过 LKO，5100 米保持，收到通播 B，现在联系武汉进近。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The attitude indicator showed a slight nose-up attitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 姿态指示仪显示飞机略呈抬头姿态。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Automation reduced the crew's workload during cruise.
words.exampleTranslation: 自动化降低了机组在巡航期间的工作负荷。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 自动驾驶仪或自动驾驶系统
words.example: The crew disconnected the autopilot after the warning.
words.exampleTranslation: 告警出现后，机组断开了自动驾驶。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 辅助的；备用辅助用途的
words.example: The mechanic checked the auxiliary pump.
words.exampleTranslation: 机务人员检查了辅助泵。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A passenger left a backpack in the overhead compartment.
words.exampleTranslation: 一名旅客把背包遗留在行李架内。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A weather balloon was reported near the departure route.
words.exampleTranslation: 离场航路附近报告有一个气象气球。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The battery bus supplied essential instruments during the electrical failure.
words.exampleTranslation: 供电失效期间，电瓶汇流条为关键仪表供电。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Violent behavior in the cabin forced the crew to divert.
words.exampleTranslation: 客舱内的暴力行为迫使机组备降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The helicopter remained below cloud during the visual approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 直升机在目视进近期间保持在云下飞行。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The tower monitored the behavior of birds near the runway.
words.exampleTranslation: 塔台监控跑道附近鸟群的活动。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Bird flu precautions affected animal transport through the airport.
words.exampleTranslation: 禽流感防控措施影响了机场动物运输。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 鸟吸入；发动机吸入鸟类
words.example: Bird ingestion caused engine vibration during the initial climb.
words.exampleTranslation: 起始爬升期间，吸鸟导致发动机振动。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Strong winds continued to blow across the airfield.
words.exampleTranslation: 大风持续吹过机场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Security searched the aircraft after a suspected bomb threat.
words.exampleTranslation: 疑似炸弹威胁后，安保人员搜查了飞机。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A loud boom was heard from the left engine.
words.exampleTranslation: 左发传来一声巨大的隆隆声。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: I'll call you back C: CCA 101, your ATC clearance will be suspended at the boundary.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员:CCA 101，你的空中交通管制许可将在边界处暂停。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The mechanic inspected the brakes after landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 着陆后，机务人员检查了制动器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The previous aircraft reported poor braking action.
words.exampleTranslation: 前一架飞机报告制动效果差。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The bus bar supplied power to essential instruments.
words.exampleTranslation: 汇流条为关键仪表供电。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 中国民用航空局（Civil Aviation Administration of China，CAAC）
words.example: CAAC conducts ramp inspections to support flight safety and regulatory compliance.
words.exampleTranslation: 中国民航局通过停机坪检查保障飞行安全和规章符合性。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Smoke was reported in the rear cabin.
words.exampleTranslation: 后客舱报告有烟雾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The cabin crew reported smoke near the rear door.
words.exampleTranslation: 客舱机组报告后舱门附近有烟雾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller asked the pilot to repeat the call sign.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员要求飞行员重复呼号。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 静风；无风或风很弱的状态
words.example: The surface wind was calm when the aircraft landed.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器着陆时地面静风。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew asked about the dangerous cargo on board.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组询问了机上危险货物的情况。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller said, "Caution, vehicles near the taxiway."
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员说:“注意，滑行道附近有车辆。”。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 中心线；跑道或滑行道中心线
words.example: The aircraft drifted away from the runway centerline.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机偏离了跑道中心线。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew completed the relevant checklist.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组完成了相应检查单。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft remained in the traffic circuit.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器保持在起落航线内。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 许可；使脱离或无障碍；无云的、畅通的
words.example: The controller cleared the aircraft to descend.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员许可该航空器下降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 空中交通管制许可；净空或间隙
words.example: The pilot requested a revised clearance.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员申请更改管制许可。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft stopped its climb at the assigned altitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器在指定高度停止爬升。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 云；影响飞行的气象要素
words.example: The helicopter remained below cloud during the visual approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 直升机在目视进近期间保持在云下飞行。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew noticed an unusual smell in the cockpit.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组注意到驾驶舱内有异常气味。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The two aircraft nearly collided on the taxiway.
words.exampleTranslation: 两架航空器在滑行道上险些相撞。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The investigation examined the causes of the collision.
words.exampleTranslation: 调查分析了这次碰撞的原因。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot followed the radio communication failure procedure.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员按照无线电通信失效处置程序操作。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: I would review the latest weather, runway conditions, and relevant notices with the crew.
words.exampleTranslation: 我会与机组重新查看最新天气、跑道状况和相关通告。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot asked ATC to confirm the assigned altitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员要求空管确认指定高度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 航空器间的潜在间隔冲突；相冲突
words.example: The controller issued a heading to resolve the traffic conflict.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员发布了一个航向以化解航空器间的冲突。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot reported negative contact with the traffic.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员报告未目视到相关航空器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Autopilot control was disconnected during the unstable approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 不稳定进近期间，自动驾驶操纵被断开。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The mechanic inspected the damaged control surface.
words.exampleTranslation: 机务人员检查了受损的操纵面。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 航道；拟沿规定路径飞行的方向或路径
words.example: The aircraft deviated from its planned course.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器偏离了计划航道。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A crack appeared on the windshield during cruise.
words.exampleTranslation: 巡航期间，风挡出现裂纹。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported a strong crosswind.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告有强侧风。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew discovered the fault during cruise.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组在巡航阶段发现了故障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 现时发生的，当前的，现在的
words.example: The pilot requested the current wind information.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员请求当前风向风速信息。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 驾驶舱语音记录器（Cockpit Voice Recorder，CVR）
words.example: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company policy on CVR monitoring.
words.exampleTranslation: 我尚未受雇于航空公司，因此没有公司的 CVR 监听政策。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The inspection revealed damage to aircraft parked near the hangar.
words.exampleTranslation: 检查发现机库附近停放的航空器受损。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft was instructed to avoid the danger area.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机被指示避开危险区。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A prohibited dangerous item was found during security screening.
words.exampleTranslation: 安检过程中发现一件违禁危险品。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew asked whether dangerous goods were on board.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组询问机上是否有危险品。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The flight data interface unit stopped transmitting engine data.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行数据接口组件停止传输发动机数据。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot had to decrease thrust during the descent.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员在下降过程中需要减小推力。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: De-icing was completed before the aircraft taxied out.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机滑出前，除冰已经完成。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Heavy snow caused long delays for departing flights.
words.exampleTranslation: 大雪造成出港航班长时间延误。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The met department issued a warning for severe turbulence.
words.exampleTranslation: 气象部门发布了严重颠簸警告。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 离场；离场程序；离场管制单位
words.example: The crew reviewed the departure before starting the engines.
words.exampleTranslation: 起动发动机前，机组复核了离场程序。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew was unable to deploy the speed brakes.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组无法放出减速板。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: At cruising altitude, cabin pressure dropped rapidly, triggering oxygen mask deployment automatically.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机在巡航高度时客舱压力迅速下降，氧气面罩自动释放。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller instructed the aircraft to descend to a lower level.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员指示航空器下降到较低高度层。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew requested an immediate descent.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组申请立即下降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 偏离；改变原航迹或程序
words.example: The crew requested permission to deviate around the weather.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组申请许可绕飞天气区。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller approved a weather deviation.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员批准了因天气进行的偏航。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The digital flight data recording system captured the abnormal event.
words.exampleTranslation: 数字式飞行数据记录系统记录了异常事件。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: ATC advised opposite direction traffic at the same level.
words.exampleTranslation: 空管通知同高度有相对飞行的航空器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: CCA 976, there is a disabled 737 on the taxiway A. follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of runway 04.
words.exampleTranslation: 国航 976，A 滑行道上有一架 B737 故障了，跟着 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 外的等待。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew disconnected the autopilot during the unstable approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 不稳定进近期间，机组断开了自动驾驶。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 自行判断权；酌情决定权
words.example: The controller approved the start at the pilot's discretion.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The flight recorder records information about the performance of an aircraft in flight, or about conditions encountered in flight.

words.exampleTranslation: 一盏泛光灯照亮了航空器停放区域。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 机组注意到滑油压力波动。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 流体；系统中的工作液体

words.exampleTranslation: 机务人员发现液压油泄漏。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft made a low flypast so the tower could observe the landing gear.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器低空通场，以便塔台观察起落架。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 飞行管理计算机（Flight Management Computer，FMC）
words.example: The aircraft was on autopilot at the time and followed its FMCS inserted route.
words.exampleTranslation: 当时飞机处于自动驾驶状态，并按照飞行管理计算机系统(FMCS)设定的航线飞行。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 飞行管理系统（Flight Management System，FMS）
words.example: The FMS provides the autopilot with guidance commands based on the flight plan.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行管理系统根据飞行计划向自动驾驶系统提供引导指令。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 外来物碎片；同一缩写也可表示外来物损伤（Foreign Object Debris，FOD）
words.example: FOD was found near the runway after departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 离场后，跑道附近发现外来物碎片。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Several passengers suffered food poisoning during the long-haul flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 长途飞行中，数名旅客出现食物中毒。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 迫降；因情况所迫不能继续正常飞行而着陆

words.exampleTranslation: 发动机动力丧失导致了一次迫降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: As far as I know, firstly, it usually cannot be foreseen or detected by aircraft radars so there is no warning.
words.exampleTranslation: 就我所知，第一，晴空湍流通常无法被预测或被雷达探测到，所以晴空湍流没有预警。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 英尺每分钟；常用于表示升降率（Feet per Minute，FPM）
words.example: The vertical speed was five hundred FPM.
words.exampleTranslation: 垂直速度为每分钟五百英尺。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The passenger appeared to have a leg fracture.
words.exampleTranslation: 这名旅客似乎发生了腿部骨折。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The freezing level was below the cruising altitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 结冰层低于巡航高度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 冻雨；过冷雨滴接触低温表面后结冰的降水
words.example: Freezing rain was reported at the destination.
words.exampleTranslation: 目的地报告有冻雨。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft was carrying freight rather than passengers.
words.exampleTranslation: 该航空器运输的是货物，而非旅客。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: On March 5, 2026, a large cargo Boeing 7 47 freighter experienced a nose gear malfunction while taxiing for departure at Dubai International Airport.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A grooved runway increases friction and prevents the plane from skidding when there is water on the runway.
words.exampleTranslation: 带槽跑道可以增加摩擦力，避免跑道上有积水时飞机打滑。

words.example: Smoke was reported in the front cabin.
words.exampleTranslation: 前舱报告有烟雾。

words.example: It can also occur near frontal weather and strong changes in surface wind.
words.exampleTranslation: 它也可能出现在锋面天气和地面风发生强烈变化的区域。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Generally, there are four types of ice. clear ice, mixed ice, rime ice and frost.
words.exampleTranslation: 通常有四种冰，分别是明冰、毛冰、雾凇冰和霜。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Holding at low altitude was consuming extra fuel.
words.exampleTranslation: 低高度等待正在消耗额外燃油。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft was vectored toward the fuel dumping area.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机被引导至放油区。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A fuel truck arrived late at the remote stand.
words.exampleTranslation: 一辆加油车晚到远机位。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Fumes entered the cabin during engine start.
words.exampleTranslation: 发动机启动期间，烟气进入客舱。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We had an electrical fire from the galley, now extinguished. Request return to land.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们有厨房电气火警，现在已经熄灭。请求返场着陆。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The maintenance team checked for gasoline leakage near the engine.
words.exampleTranslation: 维修团队检查发动机附近是否有汽油泄漏。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The fuel gauge showed less fuel than expected.
words.exampleTranslation: 燃油表显示的油量低于预期。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: From the tower, the gear appears down.
words.exampleTranslation: 从塔台观察，起落架看上去已放下。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: General aviation traffic was active near the training airport.
words.exampleTranslation: 训练机场附近通用航空活动频繁。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The left generator failed during cruise.
words.exampleTranslation: 左发电机在巡航期间失效。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 让路；优先让指定航空器通过
words.example: The controller instructed the crew to give way to another aircraft.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员指示机组给另一架航空器让路。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 下滑道；仪表着陆系统的垂直引导信号

words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告下滑道指示不可靠。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 全球导航卫星系统（Global Navigation Satellite System，GNSS）

words.exampleTranslation: 它是 GNSS 中使用最广泛的卫星导航系统之一。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 地面电源装置（Ground Power Unit，GPU）

words.exampleTranslation: 旅客登机前，地面电源已接入飞机。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 近地警告系统（Ground Proximity Warning System，GPWS）

words.exampleTranslation: GPWS 使用无线电高度表信息监控飞机相对地面的高度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: At a high-elevation airport, lower air density reduces engine performance and climb gradient.
words.exampleTranslation: 在高海拔机场，较低的空气密度会降低发动机性能和爬升梯度。

words.example: A grooved wet runway should therefore not be treated as the same as a dry runway.
words.exampleTranslation: 因此，不能把刻槽湿跑道视为与干跑道相同。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The gross weight is important, because it is the basis for determining the takeoff distance.
words.exampleTranslation: 总重很重要，因为它是确定起飞距离的依据。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 天气报告包含了三十节的阵风。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 阵风锋先于雷暴主体到达机场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: To maintain good control, the approach and turbulence air with gusty crosswind may require the use of partial flaps.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: This is necessary because a free directional gyro gradually loses alignment, while the compass remains the basic magnetic reference.
words.exampleTranslation: 这样做很有必要，因为自由式航向陀螺仪会逐渐失准，而磁罗盘仍是基本的磁航向基准。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Rescue efforts were hampered by the remote location and adverse weather.
words.exampleTranslation: 偏远的位置和恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。

words.exampleTranslation: 一名残障旅客在登机期间需要协助。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff?
words.exampleTranslation: 雷达移交时前面的管制员告诉你我们的问题了吗？

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 移交后首次联系新的管制单位时，应报告哪些信息？

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft was moved into the hangar for inspection.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机被拖入机库接受检查。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 危险源；可能造成损害的因素

words.exampleTranslation: 机组发现了滑行道上的一个危险源。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 有危险的；可能造成危害的

words.exampleTranslation: 危险天气影响了离场航路。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Haze reduced visibility during the morning departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 霾降低了早晨离场时的能见度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The passenger reported a severe headache during cruise.
words.exampleTranslation: 巡航期间，旅客报告严重头痛。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员应先检查耳机和麦克风是否工作正常，并选择正确频率。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A passenger suffered a heart attack after takeoff.
words.exampleTranslation: 起飞后，一名旅客突发心脏病。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The heat exchanger malfunction caused a cabin temperature warning.
words.exampleTranslation: 热交换器故障导致客舱温度警告。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 百帕；气压单位，缩写为 hPa

words.exampleTranslation: 下降到场高 2000 英尺，场压 997 百帕。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: HF radio provides long-range communication beyond normal VHF coverage over the ocean.
words.exampleTranslation: HF 无线电可以在海洋上空超出正常 VHF 覆盖范围时提供远程通信。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Security officers arrested the suspected hijacker after landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 落地后，安保人员逮捕了疑似劫机犯。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The holdover time expired before the aircraft reached the runway.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机到达跑道前，除冰保持时间已过期。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 安保部门报告机上可能存在人质情况。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Hot brakes were reported after the rejected takeoff.
words.exampleTranslation: 中断起飞后报告刹车过热。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 水平状态指示器（Horizontal Situation Indicator，HSI）

words.exampleTranslation: 水平状态指示器显示了错误的导航数据。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The electronic head-up display helped the pilot maintain the glide path.
words.exampleTranslation: 电子平视仪帮助飞行员保持下滑航迹。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 潮湿的；空气含水汽较多的

words.exampleTranslation: 客舱会过于潮湿，导致冷凝并可能损坏内饰。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Air density decreases as altitude, temperature, or humidity increases.
words.exampleTranslation: 随着高度、温度或湿度升高，空气密度会降低。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.exampleTranslation: 飓风迫使机场暂停运行。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The brake hydraulic system lost pressure during taxi.
words.exampleTranslation: 滑行过程中，液压刹车系统失去压力。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The hydraulic lines were damaged during the hard landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 重着陆期间，液压管路受损。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们有一名旅客有严重的过度换气症。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The instructor explained the symptoms of hypoxia.
words.exampleTranslation: 教员解释了缺氧的症状。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The passenger became hypoxic after the oxygen supply failed.
words.exampleTranslation: 供氧失效后，旅客出现了缺氧。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller reported, "Identification lost."
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员通报:“识别丢失。”。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 整体驱动发电机（Integrated Drive Generator，IDG）

words.exampleTranslation: 电气故障后，整体驱动发电机自动脱开。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 仪表飞行规则（Instrument Flight Rules，IFR）
words.example: According to AIM, the pilot should file an IFR flight plan at least four hours before departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 根据《航空信息手册》(AIM)，飞行员应在起飞前至少四小时提交仪表飞行规则(IFR)飞行计划。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A passenger ignited the lavatory waste bin. Advise the airport police to await our arrival.
words.exampleTranslation: 一名旅客点燃了盥洗室垃圾桶。告知机场警察到场来处理。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The key to fire prevention is keeping fuel and ignition sources separate.
words.exampleTranslation: 防火的关键是使燃料和火源保持隔离。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Runway illumination was reduced during the power failure.
words.exampleTranslation: 供电故障期间，跑道照明减弱。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A visual illusion made the runway appear closer than normal.
words.exampleTranslation: 视觉错觉使跑道看起来比实际更近。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 仪表气象条件（Instrument Meteorological Conditions，IMC）
words.example: A flight was on NDB approach to runway 28 in instrument meteorological conditions.
words.exampleTranslation: 在仪表气象条件下，一架飞机在 NDB 进近 28 号跑道。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Fatigue can impair judgment, slow reaction time, and reduce situational awareness.
words.exampleTranslation: 疲劳会损害判断力、减慢反应速度并降低情景意识。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: While you can minimize barometric altimeter errors, you cannot entirely eliminate the common inaccuracies caused by non-standard atmospheric conditions.
words.exampleTranslation: 尽管你可以减低气压高度表的读数错误，但是你却不能完全消除因非标准大气条件引起的常见误差。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew usually has inadequate awareness of the approaching collision until it is too late.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组通常未能充分意识到即将发生的碰撞，直至为时已晚。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck.
words.exampleTranslation: 襟翼无意中被放出，碰到了油车。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 内侧的；靠近机身中心线的
words.example: The inboard aileron and the fuselage just aft of the baggage door were punctured by debris.
words.exampleTranslation: 内侧副翼以及行李舱门后方的机身被碎片击穿。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 失能的；无法履行职责的
words.example: The first officer became incapacitated during the flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 副驾驶在飞行过程中失能。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 失能；不能履行职责的状态

words.exampleTranslation: 机组演练了飞行员失能情景。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: There are many factors that can cause crew's incapacity.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 侵入；不正确进入受保护区域

words.example: Yes, I have sometimes felt overworked during periods of intensive study and flight training.
words.exampleTranslation: 是的，在学习和飞行训练密集的阶段，我有时会感到过度劳累。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: However, the term also means a landing that has been forced by interception.

words.example: CVR is used to record audio in the cockpit, on radio and intercom communications.

words.example: The flight data interface unit stopped transmitting engine data.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行数据接口组件停止传输发动机数据。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: When the aircraft flies in ground effect, the ground interferes with the wingtip vortex, which reduces drag.
words.exampleTranslation: 当飞机在地面效应范围内飞行时，地面会干扰翼尖涡流，从而减小阻力。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Radio interference made the transmission difficult to hear.
words.exampleTranslation: 无线电干扰使发话难以听清。

words.example: The No. 2 engine produced intermittent noises, as a precaution, you want to terminate the flight and return.

words.example: The operating crew should first try to contact the resting crew member through the interphone.

words.example: A failure in the pitot static system can result in incorrect airspeed and altitude readings, which can compromise flight safety and require immediate pilot intervention.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A pilot rejects takeoff resulting from many reasons, such as system failure, engine fire, engine flame out, wind shear, master warning light illuminated, incorrect aircraft configuration, runway intrusion and ATC's instruction.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员中止起飞有多种原因，如系统故障、发动机着火、发动机熄火、风切变、主警告灯照明、飞机配置误差、跑道侵入和 ATC 指令出错。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: There was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: I think, during irregular operations, the operation principle is not let fatigue affect safety.
words.exampleTranslation: 我认为，在非正常运行中，运行原则是不要让疲劳影响安全。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 惯性基准系统（Inertial Reference System，IRS）

words.exampleTranslation: GPS 信号丢失后，惯性导航系统提供姿态信息。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: For an electrical fire, isolate power to the affected equipment if it is safe to do so.
words.exampleTranslation: 对于电气火灾，如果能够安全操作，应切断受影响设备的电源。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew confirmed the isolation of the faulty electrical bus.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组确认已隔离故障汇流条。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us. We are near the zero-degree isotherm. Request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If possible, they can cross-check their position with visible landmarks.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: I prefer an ILS approach because it provides both lateral and vertical guidance.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The smoke alarm came from the rear lavatory.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Pilots can know fuel endurance from fuel gauge or MFD.

words.exampleTranslation: 机场附近报告有微下击暴流。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot's mic failed during radio communication.
words.exampleTranslation: 无线电通信期间，飞行员的话筒失效。

words.example: This helps prevent mid-air collisions and allows for a smooth and safe flow of air traffic.

words.example: The aircraft maintained minimum approach speed on final.

words.example: Such as strong wind, improper use of flight control, miscalculation of CG, incorrect input to FMC and so on.

words.example: These vibrations and noises might suggest issues such as a misfiring cylinder, a problem with the engine's rotating parts, or a fault in the fuel or air intake systems.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: As far as I know, there are three landing risk factors may precede a tail strike, they are unstabilized approach, mishandling of crosswinds, and over-rotation during missed approach.

words.example: The NTSB found the fire crew had misheard ATC clearance and entered the active runway without authorization.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: In this serious incident, it is highly probable that because the captain of the aircraft misidentified the runway.

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The reading may fluctuate and mislead the pilots.
words.exampleTranslation: 读数可能发生波动并误导飞行员。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The investigation found that a misoperation had damaged the valve.

words.meaning: 复飞；仪表进近未继续着陆时实施的复飞程序

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Pilot radio communication should be standardized so as to avoid any misunderstanding.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员无线电通信应标准化，以避免误解。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Anti-lock braking systems prevent wheel lockup by modulating brake pressure, allowing the wheels to continue rotating and maintaining directional control.
words.exampleTranslation: 防抱死制动系统通过调节刹车压力防止机轮抱死，使机轮能够继续转动并保持方向控制。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The developing stage is dominated by updrafts as moisture condenses and the cloud grows.
words.exampleTranslation: 发展阶段以上升气流为主，水汽凝结，云体增长。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 最低安全高度（Minimum Safe Altitude，MSA）；航图语境中也可指最低扇区高度（Minimum Sector Altitude，MSA）
words.example: The crew checked the MSA before starting the approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 开始进近前，机组检查了最低扇区高度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The chart gives the elevation in feet above MSL.
words.exampleTranslation: 航图以高于平均海平面的英尺数标示标高。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 最大起飞重量（Maximum Takeoff Weight，MTOW）
words.example: The aircraft weight was below the approved MTOW.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器重量低于批准的最大起飞重量。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 泥；未铺装跑道、机场地面或污染物
words.example: The aircraft became stuck in mud beside the taxiway.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机陷在滑行道旁的泥里。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Multiple warnings appeared after the electrical failure.
words.exampleTranslation: 供电故障后出现多个警告。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 最低引导高度（Minimum Vectoring Altitude，MVA）
words.example: The controller could not descend the aircraft below the MVA.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员不能指挥飞机下降到最低引导高度以下。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew should confirm that the nacelle and cowling are secure and that the intake is clear of FOD.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组应确认短舱和整流罩固定可靠，进气口内没有外来物。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 导航；确定并保持航行路线
words.example: Inertial reference system has failed. We are navigating on raw data. Request conventional approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 惯导失效了，我们正在使用原始导航，申请传统进近。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If the GPS system fails, pilots can switch to using traditional navigation aids like VOR and ND.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果 GPS 系统失效，飞行员可以切换到使用传统的导航辅助设备，如 VOR 和 ND。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Pilots must not neglect the effect of fatigue on performance.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员不能忽视疲劳对表现的影响。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The departure followed the airport noise abatement procedure.
words.exampleTranslation: 离场按照机场降噪程序执行。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller applied non-radar separation.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员采用了非雷达间隔。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The non-scheduled flight required special handling at the airport.
words.exampleTranslation: 该非定期航班需要机场特殊保障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The latter includes nonprecision approach runway, and precision approach runway categoryI, II, and III according to its serving visual aids, decision height (DH) and Runway Visual Range (RVR).
words.exampleTranslation: 仪表跑道根据目视助航设备、决断高度和跑道视程分为非精密进近跑道、I 类精密进近跑道、II 类精密进近跑道和 III 类精密进近跑道。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Rapid decompression can lead to hypoxia and physical symptoms like dizziness and nosebleeds, but not increased body temperature.
words.exampleTranslation: 快速失压可能导致缺氧，并出现头晕和流鼻血等身体症状，但不会导致体温升高。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The NOTAM says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period, please verify.
words.exampleTranslation: 航行通告说部分滑行道在这期间关闭。请核实。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 美国国家运输安全委员会（National Transportation Safety Board，NTSB）
words.example: The NTSB preliminary report ruled out engine failure, focusing on a faulty elevator control mechanism.
words.exampleTranslation: NTSB 初步报告排除了发动机故障，调查重点为升降舵操纵机构故障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Smoke can obscure the runway lights.
words.exampleTranslation: 烟雾会遮蔽跑道灯光。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Both our windshield heating systems have failed. Ice is obstructing our view. Request latest airport weather.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们风挡加温系统故障了，冰挡住了我们的视线。申请最新的机场天气。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A runway obstruction prevented the aircraft from landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 跑道上的障碍物使航空器无法着陆。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Navigational facility, a fix, or specified distance OCA or OCH from the final approach fix.
words.exampleTranslation: 也可能是导航设施点、一个定位点，或者是距最后进近定位点的指定距离的最低超障高度(OCA)或最低超障高(OCH)。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller monitored runway occupancy during the busy period.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员在繁忙时段监控跑道占用情况。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: All occupants left the aircraft safely.
words.exampleTranslation: 机上所有人员均安全离开航空器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We are evacuating. Advise emergency personnel that fuel odors are still present in the cabin.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们正在紧急撤离。请告诉地面人员机上仍然有燃油味道。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The airline decided to offload cargo before departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空公司决定起飞前卸下货物。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: According to FAR, the minimum equipment required for flight in terminal control area, is the two-way radio, transponder and very-high-frequency omnidirectional radio range.
words.exampleTranslation: 根据联邦航空条例，在航空终端站控制区飞行时，需要的最低设备是双向无线电设备，应答机，甚高频全向无电线信标。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The onboard camera showed smoke near the landing gear.
words.exampleTranslation: 机载摄像机显示起落架附近有烟雾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported oncoming traffic on the taxiway.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告滑行道上有迎面而来的航空器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: An open flame was reported near the cargo area.
words.exampleTranslation: 货运区域附近报告有明火。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot discussed the diversion option with dispatch.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员与签派讨论了备降选择。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: In IMC, pilots rely solely on instruments for navigation and orientation.
words.exampleTranslation: 在 IMC 中，飞行员完全依靠仪表进行导航和定向。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 外侧的；远离机身中心线的
words.example: Ailerons at outboard ends of wings is controlling roll, pitch control by the elevator, and rudder controls yaw.
words.exampleTranslation: 副翼位于机翼外侧端，控制滚转;升降舵控制俯仰;方向舵控制偏航。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported an outbreak of fire in the cabin.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告客舱突然起火。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: To regulate the opening and closing of the outflow valve.
words.exampleTranslation: 调节排气活门的开关。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: China Civil Aviation Regulations (CCAR) prohibit takeoff when snow, ice, or frost is adhering to wings, propellers, control surfaces, engine outlets, and other critical surfaces of the aircraft.
words.exampleTranslation: 中国民航规章中禁止飞机在机翼、螺旋桨、操纵面、引擎或飞机其它操纵面上在有雪、结冰、结霜的情况下起飞。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The destination was overcast with low cloud base.
words.exampleTranslation: 目的地满天云且云底较低。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们发现一名旅客在洗手间服药(或毒品)过量失去意识了。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A Pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways. Request to terminate our approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞越的一名飞行员报告在跑道上空看见了雨幡。申请终止进近。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Smoke was reported from an overhead compartment during boarding.
words.exampleTranslation: 登机期间，客舱行李架报告有烟雾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The warning light appeared on the overhead panel.
words.exampleTranslation: 告警灯出现在顶部仪表板上。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft flew over an overpass on short final.
words.exampleTranslation: 短五边时，飞机飞越一座高架桥。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 人工超控；使自动指令失效
words.example: Some aircraft have a manual override system as a backup in case of a primary hydraulic system failure.
words.exampleTranslation: 某些航空器配有人工超控系统，作为主液压系统失效时的备用系统。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 超过预定位置；飞过目标位置
words.example: The pilot reported an overshoot and requested another approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员报告复飞，并申请再次进近。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The faster aircraft was instructed not to overtake the traffic ahead.
words.exampleTranslation: 较快的航空器被指示不要追越前方航空器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Overwater operations also require additional lifesaving equipment and preparation.
words.exampleTranslation: 水上运行还需要额外救生设备和准备。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft was overweight for immediate landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机超过立即着陆的重量限制。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: I heard about a passenger opening an overwing emergency exit on the ground, which caused the slide to deploy.
words.exampleTranslation: 我听说过一名旅客在地面打开翼上应急出口，导致滑梯放出的事件。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A caution light appeared on the overhead panel.
words.exampleTranslation: 顶部面板上出现一个警示灯。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 精密进近航径指示器（Precision Approach Path Indicator，PAPI）
words.example: For example, two red and two white lights indicate that the aircraft is on the PAPI path.
words.exampleTranslation: 例如，两红两白表示飞机位于正确的精密进近航径上。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 精密进近雷达（Precision Approach Radar，PAR）
words.example: The controller reported that the PAR was unserviceable.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员报告精密进近雷达不可用。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew monitored the engine parameters.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组监控了发动机参数。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.word: passenger boarding bridge / air bridge / airbridge / jetway / loading bridge
words.example: The airbridge was connected after the aircraft reached the gate.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机到达登机口后，廊桥被接上。
words.pronunciationText: passenger boarding bridge. air bridge. airbridge. jetway. loading bridge

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Passenger stairs were requested for the remote parking stand.
words.exampleTranslation: 远机位请求了客梯车。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A passenger was denied boarding because of an expired passport.
words.exampleTranslation: 一名旅客因护照过期被拒绝登机。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The patient needed oxygen during the descent.
words.exampleTranslation: 下降期间，该病人需要吸氧。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The airport upgraded runway drainage systems and added anti-slip pavement layers.
words.exampleTranslation: 机场升级了跑道排水系统并增设防滑路面层。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If the calculation requires it, the takeoff weight can be reduced by carrying less payload.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果计算结果有要求，可以通过减少业载来降低起飞重量。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: It is part of PBN and supports accurate navigation directly from one waypoint to another.
words.exampleTranslation: 它是 PBN 的一部分，支持飞机从一个航路点准确地直接飞往另一个航路点。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot requested permission to leave the frequency.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员请求离开该频率的许可。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If problem persists, I will turn alternator/generator off, start conserve battery power and request priority landing at the nearest airport.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果问题仍未解决，我会关闭发电机，节省电量，并请求优先降落在最近的机场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 主飞行显示器（Primary Flight Display，PFD）
words.example: The crew reported that both the captains and co-pilots PFDs and NDs didn't work, nor did the upper ECAM display.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组人员报告称，机长和副驾驶的主飞行显示器(PFD)和导航显示器(ND)均无法工作，上部的电子中央监控系统(ECAM)显示屏也不工作了。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 措辞体系；航空通话用语
words.example: Standard phraseology helps reduce misunderstandings.
words.exampleTranslation: 标准通话用语有助于减少误解。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 地标领航；依靠可见地标导航
words.example: The pilot used pilotage to identify the route by visible landmarks.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员采用地标领航，通过可见地标辨认路线。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 管道；空气、燃油、液压或排气管路
words.example: Maintenance inspected the blow pipe after abnormal engine indications appeared.
words.exampleTranslation: 发动机参数异常后，维修人员检查了喷油嘴。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop".
words.exampleTranslation: 最初，空中交通管制中心收到飞行员报告，称机组人员当时经历了“轻度颠簸”。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Turbine engines normally use jet fuel, while many piston engines use aviation gasoline.
words.exampleTranslation: 涡轮发动机通常使用喷气燃料，而许多活塞发动机使用航空汽油。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pitot de-icer was switched on before entering cloud.
words.exampleTranslation: 进入云层前，全静压管除冰装置被接通。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 皮托管；空速测压相关探头
words.example: Ice blocked one of the pitot tubes.
words.exampleTranslation: 冰堵塞了其中一根皮托管。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 机上人数；机上人员总数（Persons on Board，POB）
words.example: The pilot reported one hundred fifty persons on board.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员报告机上共有一百五十人。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A large pool of water remained on the taxiway.
words.exampleTranslation: 滑行道上仍有一大片积水。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported damage to the port engine.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告左发动机受损。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A power line was reported near the emergency landing site.
words.exampleTranslation: 紧急着陆地点附近报告有电力线。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The power supply failed during boarding.
words.exampleTranslation: 登机期间，电源失效。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 推力倒滑；使用航空器自身反推力向后移动
words.example: The operator did not permit a powerback at that stand.
words.exampleTranslation: 运营人不允许在该停机位进行推力倒滑。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Land as soon as practicable.
words.exampleTranslation: 在切实可行时尽快着陆。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew discussed precautions for the ground operation.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组讨论了地面运行的防范措施。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 降水；降水量（包括雨、雪、冰等）
words.example: Heavy precipitation reduced visibility on final approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 强降水降低了最后进近时的能见度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot stated a preference for runway two-seven.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员表示优先选择二七号跑道。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A pregnant woman requested medical help during boarding.
words.exampleTranslation: 一名孕妇在登机期间请求医疗帮助。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The NTSB preliminary report ruled out engine failure, focusing on a faulty elevator control mechanism.
words.exampleTranslation: NTSB 初步报告排除了发动机故障，调查重点为升降舵操纵机构故障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The cabin pressurization system was not working normally.
words.exampleTranslation: 座舱增压系统工作不正常。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 增压问题；增压系统异常
words.example: The crew requested descent because of a pressurization problem.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组因增压问题申请下降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The system failed to pressurize the cabin.
words.exampleTranslation: 该系统未能给座舱增压。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The smoke presumably came from the cargo compartment.
words.exampleTranslation: 烟雾可能来自货舱。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 优先处理；确定优先顺序
words.example: To prioritize the comfort of the flight attendants over the safety of the aircraft.
words.exampleTranslation: 把乘务员舒适置于航空器安全之上。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We made the overshoot because of a stall warning, probably caused by a defective angle of attack probe.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们复飞是因为失速警告，可能是迎角探头有故障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew briefed the CAT II ILS procedure before approach.
words.exampleTranslation: 进近前，机组简令了二类盲降程序。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 熟练程度；语言或操作能力
words.example: So I think watching English movies or programs is a good way to improve our English proficiency.
words.exampleTranslation: 因此，我认为看英文电影或节目是提高我们英语水平的好办法。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The notice says that smoking is prohibited.
words.exampleTranslation: 告示上写着禁止吸烟。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: They can also avoid prolonged holding and unnecessary maneuvers and maintain stable flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们还可以避免长时间等待和不必要的机动，并保持稳定飞行。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The props were inspected after the gravel strike.
words.exampleTranslation: 碎石击中后，螺旋桨接受了检查。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew received a ground proximity warning.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组收到了近地警告。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 驶离；驶向路边；在道路语境中可表示靠边停车
words.example: The driver was asked to pull off the road and stop.
words.exampleTranslation: 驾驶员被要求驶向路边停车。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Hydraulic pump failure affected the normal braking system.
words.exampleTranslation: 液压泵失效影响了正常刹车系统。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The passenger received pure oxygen after reporting breathing difficulty.
words.exampleTranslation: 旅客报告呼吸困难后接受了纯氧。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The captain tried to put into words what had happened.
words.exampleTranslation: 机长试着用语言描述发生的事情。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 预测式风切变系统（Predictive Windshear System，PWS）
words.example: Comparatively speaking, the alerting time of PWS is much longer than that of the RWS.
words.exampleTranslation: 相比而言，预测性风切变系统的报警时间比反应式风切变系统要长。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 标准气压设置；通常采用 1013.25 百帕作为飞行高度层基准
words.example: The crew changed the altimeter setting to QNE.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组将高度表调整为标准气压设置。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 快速检查手册（Quick Reference Handbook，QRH）
words.example: A QRH gives the crew checklists and procedures to follow when an emergency occurs.
words.exampleTranslation: 发生紧急情况时，快速参考手册(QRH)为机组提供需要执行的检查单和程序。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot's qualification was checked before the training flight.
words.exampleTranslation: 训练飞行前检查了飞行员资质。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 决断咨询；防撞系统提供的避撞机动指引（Resolution Advisory，RA）
words.example: The crew followed the RA to avoid conflicting traffic.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组按照决策咨询避开冲突航空器。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 径向线；从导航台向外的方位线；径向的
words.example: The aircraft crossed the specified radial.
words.exampleTranslation: 航空器穿越了指定径向线。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Radioactive, flammable, explosive, toxic, and corrosive substances may also be classified as dangerous goods.
words.exampleTranslation: 放射性、易燃、爆炸性、有毒和腐蚀性物质也可能被归类为危险品。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The ramp controller guided the aircraft to the assigned stand.
words.exampleTranslation: 机坪管制员引导飞机到指定机位。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.word: rapid decompression / rapid depressurization / quick depressurization
words.example: Rapid depressurization occurred shortly after reaching cruise altitude.
words.exampleTranslation: 到达巡航高度后不久发生快速释压。
words.pronunciationText: rapid decompression. rapid depressurization. quick depressurization

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 冲压空气涡轮（Ram Air Turbine，RAT）
words.example: A ram air turbine that can generate emergency power.
words.exampleTranslation: 一台可产生应急动力的冲压空气涡轮。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 转弯率；单位时间内航向的变化量
words.example: The rate of turn increased during the steep bank.
words.exampleTranslation: 大坡度转弯时，转弯率增加。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 执照等级；批准的资格或权限类别
words.example: I would need to complete the approved training and checks before holding any type rating.
words.exampleTranslation: 取得任何型别等级前，我都需要完成批准的训练和检查。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 反应式的；对已发生情况作出响应的
words.example: And in AC circuits, the power can be categorized into real, reactive, and apparent power.
words.exampleTranslation: 在 AC 电路中，功率可分为有功功率、无功功率和视在功率。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller reported poor readability on the pilot's transmission.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员报告飞行员通话可读性差。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller could no longer see the aircraft's altitude readout.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员无法再看到该航空器的高度读数。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If exceed 15 minutes, slot time will be reallocated.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果超过 15 分钟，将重新分配离场时间。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Smoke was reported in the rear cabin after takeoff.
words.exampleTranslation: 起飞后，后舱报告有烟雾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We would reassess the plan, clarify our tasks, and review any required de-icing procedures.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们会重新评估计划，明确分工，并复习需要执行的除冰程序。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We have to recalibrate our instruments. Request to level off and maintain heading.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们需要重新校准仪表。申请改平飞并保持航向。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The radio receiver was not working properly.
words.exampleTranslation: 无线电接收机工作不正常。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: They can dynamically reconfigure displays to suit different phases of flight or emergencies.
words.exampleTranslation: 它们可以根据不同飞行阶段或紧急情况动态重新配置显示内容。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 定期复训的；反复发生的
words.example: The pilot completed recurrent training last month.
words.exampleTranslation: 这名飞行员上个月完成了复训。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 重新循环；按程序重新操作开关或系统
words.example: A system that recycles cabin air to increase oxygen concentration.
words.exampleTranslation: 通过循环客舱空气提高氧气浓度的系统。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Paper manuals remain useful as a backup, so keeping both provides redundancy.
words.exampleTranslation: 纸质手册仍可作为备份，因此同时保留两种形式可以提供冗余。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 冗余的；为提高可靠性而重复设置的
words.example: The A380 has segregated, redundant flight control power sources and backup systems.
words.exampleTranslation: A380 的飞行操纵系统具有相互隔离的冗余动力来源和备用系统。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 登记；注册；航空器注册标志
words.example: The report included the aircraft's registration.
words.exampleTranslation: 报告包含了航空器的注册标志。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The air conditioning system uses a thermostat to regulate the temperature in the aircraft cabin.
words.exampleTranslation: 空调系统使用恒温器调节航空器客舱温度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The oxygen regulator controls the flow and pressure of oxygen to the masks.
words.exampleTranslation: 氧气调节器控制面罩的氧气流量和压力。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: CAAC conducts ramp inspections to support flight safety and regulatory compliance.
words.exampleTranslation: 中国民航局通过停机坪检查保障飞行安全和规章符合性。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Altitude and ambient temperature significantly affect the success of reigniting a flameout, as they influence air density and combustion efficiency.
words.exampleTranslation: 高度和环境温度会显著影响发动机熄火后重新点火的成功率，因为它们会影响空气密度和燃烧效率。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported the reason for the rejected takeoff.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告了中断起飞的原因。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot offered to relay the distress message.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员提出帮助转报遇险信息。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 可靠性；设备、系统或运行持续正确工作的能力
words.example: The reliability of radio aids was questioned after signal fluctuations.
words.exampleTranslation: 信号波动后，导航台可靠性受到质疑。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew attempted an engine relight.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组尝试使发动机重新点火。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 重新定位；重新安排位置
words.example: CTL: UAL567, roger, turn right heading 340 for reposition on the localizer.
words.exampleTranslation: 管:美联航 567，收到，右转航向 340 重新截获航道。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 改变航路；重新安排路线
words.example: The controller had to reroute the aircraft around the storm.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员需要调整航路，引导航空器绕开雷暴。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Police rescue team assistance was requested for the security incident.
words.exampleTranslation: 因安全事件，请求警方救援队协助。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 重新排序；调整进近或离场次序
words.example: ATC had to resequence the arriving aircraft.
words.exampleTranslation: 空管需要重新安排进场航空器的次序。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Pilots should not avoid a necessary go-around or reduce reserve fuel simply to save fuel.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员不能为了省油而避免必要的复飞或减少储备燃油。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: All systems share the same reservoir and pump to reduce weight.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有系统共用同一油箱和泵以减轻重量。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: They move the controls through the required range and confirm that they move freely, in the correct direction, and without unusual resistance.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们会按要求的范围活动操纵装置，确认其运动顺畅、方向正确且没有异常阻力。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Maintenance resolved the fault before the next departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 下一次离场前，维修人员解决了故障。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Unlike on a wet runway, the grooves may not drain the contaminant or restore normal tyre contact.
words.exampleTranslation: 与湿跑道不同，刻槽可能无法排走污染物或恢复正常轮胎接触。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: If they continue and cannot be controlled, an air marshal who is on board may restrain them.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果他们继续打斗且无法控制，机上的空中警察可以对其进行约束。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The loadmaster checked each cargo restraint.
words.exampleTranslation: 装载员检查了每一处货物约束装置。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The planned route passed near a restricted area.
words.exampleTranslation: 计划航路经过一个限制区附近。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The controller instructed the aircraft to resume own navigation.
words.exampleTranslation: 管制员指示航空器恢复自主导航。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 减小；延缓；在推力语境中指减小推力
words.example: Meanwhile I should retard the affected engine thrust to idle and shut it down.
words.exampleTranslation: 同时我应阻止失效的发动机空转推车并关闭它。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: We stop taxi and holding present position, request ground service to retrieve the baggage.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们停止滑行，原地等待，请求地面工作人员收走行李。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A thrust reverser redirects engine exhaust forward to create reverse thrust after landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 反推装置在着陆后把发动机排气向前偏转，产生反向推力。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: CPDLC terminated due to failure, reverting to voice communication.
words.exampleTranslation: 由于故障终止 CPDLC，恢复语音通信。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure.
words.exampleTranslation: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的旅客恢复了意识。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: During final approach in heavy rain and low visibility, the plane struck a mountain ridge shortly before landing.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机在大雨和低能见度条件下实施最后进近时，于着陆前不久撞上山脊。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 所需导航性能（Required Navigation Performance，RNP）
words.example: Two of our display units have failed. We are no longer RNP qualified. Request diversion.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们的两个显示屏故障。我们不再具备 RNP 资格。申请备降。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The aircraft began to rotate during the takeoff roll.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞机在起飞滑跑过程中开始抬前轮。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 抬轮；起飞时抬起机头的动作
words.example: When taking off, the aircraft needs more distance to reach the rotation speed (VR).
words.exampleTranslation: 当起飞的时候，飞机需要更长的滑跑距离来到达抬轮速度。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The technician inspected the rotor for damage.
words.exampleTranslation: 技术员检查了转子是否受损。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The crew reported rough running of the engine.
words.exampleTranslation: 机组报告发动机运转不平稳。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The engine RPM fluctuated during the climb.
words.exampleTranslation: 爬升期间，发动机每分钟转数出现波动。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: During ground training, I also completed a course in English radiotelephony communication.
words.exampleTranslation: 地面训练期间，我还完成了英语无线电通话课程。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Trash was found on the taxiway before departure.
words.exampleTranslation: 离场前，滑行道上发现垃圾。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The pilot reported unusual pressure on the rudder pedals.
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员报告方向舵脚蹬压力异常。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: On February 17, 2005, an Airbus 320 operated by United Airline, collided with an ERJ 145, operated by US Airways during taxi in the runup area of taxiway J at the north end of runway 19.
words.exampleTranslation: 2005 年 2 月 17 日，美国联合航空公司运营的一架空客 A320 飞机，在 19 号跑道北端 J 滑行道的准备起飞滑行区域滑行时，与美国全美航空公司运营的一架巴西航空工业公司 ERJ 145 飞机发生了碰撞。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Runway braking action was reported poor after snowfall.
words.exampleTranslation: 降雪后，跑道刹车效应报告为差。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A runway snow blower cleared the centerline before departures resumed.
words.exampleTranslation: 离场恢复前，吹雪车清理了跑道中线。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 可持续航空燃料（Sustainable Aviation Fuel，SAF）
words.example: SAF can produce lower lifecycle carbon emissions than conventional jet fuel.
words.exampleTranslation: SAF 的全生命周期碳排放可以低于传统喷气燃料。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The display shows SAT separately from total air temperature.
words.exampleTranslation: 显示器将静温与总温分别显示。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The satellite telephone was used after radio contact was lost.
words.exampleTranslation: 无线电联系中断后使用了卫星电话。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: 请再说一遍；请重发指定内容
words.example: The pilot said, "Say again your last instruction."
words.exampleTranslation: 飞行员说:“请再说一遍上一条指令。”。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.meaning: （气象） 疏云；云量为八分之三至八分之四的云层
words.example: The report indicated scattered clouds at two thousand feet.
words.exampleTranslation: 报告显示两千英尺高度有疏云。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Emergency vehicles arrived quickly at the accident scene.
words.exampleTranslation: 应急车辆迅速到达事故现场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The scheduled flight departed ten minutes behind time.
words.exampleTranslation: 该定期航班延误十分钟离场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Sparks flew as the twisted gear scraped the runway, but the pilots kept the aircraft under control.
words.exampleTranslation: 扭转的起落架在跑道上摩擦时火花四溅，但飞行员始终保持对飞机的控制。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Probably the carry-on baggage is not very carefully checked and the screening machine fails to detect it.
words.exampleTranslation: 也许随身行李并没有被仔细检查，或者安检机器没能探测到它。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A damaged seal caused hydraulic fluid leakage.
words.exampleTranslation: 一个受损密封圈导致液压油泄漏。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A security guard escorted the passenger back to the terminal.
words.exampleTranslation: 一名安全员护送旅客返回航站楼。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: A security van followed the aircraft to the remote stand.
words.exampleTranslation: 一辆保安车辆跟随飞机到远机位。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The A380 has segregated, redundant flight control power sources and backup systems.
words.exampleTranslation: A380 的飞行操纵系统具有相互隔离的冗余动力来源和备用系统。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: Our brakes have seized. The tyres might burst during touchdown. Request fire trucks on arrival.
words.exampleTranslation: 我们的刹车卡死了。可能接地时轮胎会爆胎。申请消防车到场。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The fuel selector valves are used to select fuel from various tanks which normally contain four positions: LEFT, RIGHT, BOTH, and OFF.
words.exampleTranslation: 燃油选择活门用于从各个油箱中选择燃油，通常包含四个位置:左、右、双和关。

source.name: 用户人工复审与逐词编辑

words.example: The faulty sensor gave an incorrect temperature reading.
words.exampleTranslation: 故障传感器给出了错误的温度读数。
